items.text: Mu mwaka ogwokubiri ogw'okufuga kwa kabaka Daliyo, ku lunaku olusooka mu mwezi ogw'omukaaga, ekigambo kya
ne kijjira nnabbi Kaggayi okutegeeza Zerubbaberi mutabani wa Seyalutyeri, ow'essaza lya Yuda, ne Yoswa mutabani wa Yekozadaaki kabona asinga obukulu nti:
ow'eggye nti, "Abantu bano boogera nti, 'Ekiseera tekinnatuuka okuddaabiriza ennyumba ya
ne kijjira nnabbi Kaggayi nga kyogera nti;
"Kino kye kiseera mmwe okubeera mu nnyumba zammwe enkole obulungi, naye ennyumba eyo n'erekebwa nga kifulukwa?"
Musimbye bingi naye ne mukungula bitono; mulya naye temukkuta; munywa naye ennyonta tebaggwaako; mwambala naye temubuguma; mukolera empeera naye ze mukoze muziteeka mu nsawo ejjudde ebituli."
Mwambuke mu nsozi muleeteyo embaawo muzimbe ennyumba ngisanyukire, ngulumizibwe," bw'ayogera
"Mwasuubira bingi, naye mulaba bwe muvuddemu ebitono. Bye mwaleeta eka, nabifuumuula. Mumanyi ensonga? bw'ayogera
ow'Eggye. Kubanga buli muntu afa ku nnyumba ye naye ennyumba yange mugigayaaliridde.
Eggulu kyerivudde liziyizibwa okuleeta omusulo, n'ettaka n'okuleeta ne litaleeta bibala byalyo.
Nasindika ekyeya ku nnimiro ne ku nsozi, ku mmere ey'empeke ne ku wayini omuggya, ku mafuta ne ku buli bibala eby'ettaka, ku bantu ne ku nsolo, ne ku mirimu gyonna egy'engalo."
Awo Zerubbaberi mutabani wa Seyalutyeri, ne Yoswa mutabani wa Yekozadaaki, ye yali kabona asinga obukulu, n'abantu bonna abaasigalawo ne bagondera eddoboozi lya
Katonda waabwe, n'obubaka bwa nnabbi Kaggayi, kubanga
Katonda waabwe ye yamutuma. Abantu ne batya

n'akubiriza omutima gwa Zerubbaberi mutabani wa Seyalutyeri, ow'essaza lya Yuda, n'omutima gwa Yoswa mutabani wa Yekozadaaki, kabona asinga obukulu, n'emitima egy'abantu bonna abaasigalawo, ne bajja ne batandika omulimu ku nnyumba ya
ku lunaku olw'amakumi abiri mu ennya mu mwezi ogw'omukaaga mu mwaka ogwokubiri ogw'okufuga kwa kabaka Daliyo.

items.text: Awo ku lunaku olw'amakumi abiri mu olumu mu mwezi ogw'omusanvu, ekigambo kya
"Yogera ne Zerubbaberi mutabani wa Seyalutyeri, ow'essaza lya Yuda ne Yoswa mutabani wa Yekozadaaki kabona asinga obukulu, n'abantu abaasigalawo, obabuuze nti,
'Ani mu mmwe akyasigaddewo eyalaba ku kitiibwa ky'ennyumba eno? Ebafaananira etya kaakano? Tebafaananira ng'eteriimu kaabuntu?
Kale nno guma omwoyo, ggwe Zerubbaberi, bw'ayogera
; guma omwoyo, ggwe Yoswa mutabani wa Yekozadaaki kabona asinga obukulu; mugume omwoyo mmwe mwenna abantu ab'omu nsi,' bw'ayogera
'Kino kye nalagaana nammwe bwe mwali muva mu Misiri, ng'Omwoyo wange anaabeeranga nammwe. Temutya.'
ow'Eggye nti, 'Mu bbanga eritali ly'ewala ndikankanya eggulu n'ensi, n'ennyanja n'olukalu.
Ndikankanya amawanga gonna, n'amawanga gonna ge njagala galijja, ne nzijuza ennyumba eno ekitiibwa,' bw'ayogera
'Ekitiibwa eky'ennyumba eriwo kaakano, kirisinga ekitiibwa ky'eri eyasooka era mu kifo kino ndizzaawo emirembe,' bw'ayogera
Awo ku lunaku olw'amakumi abiri mu ennya olw'omwezi ogw'omwenda mu mwaka ogwokubiri ogw'okufuga kwa Daliyo, ekigambo kya
ow'Eggye nti, 'Buuza bakabona etteeka kye ligamba.
Omuntu bw'asitulira ennyama eyatukuzibwa mu kirenge eky'ekyambalo kye, ekirenge ne kikoma ku mugaati oba ku supu, oba ku wayini, oba ku mafuta oba ku mmere endala yonna, bitukuzibwa?' "
Awo Kaggayi n'abuuza nti, "Omuntu atali mulongoofu olw'omulambo, bw'akoma ku bintu ebyo, bifuuka ebitali birongoofu?"
Bakabona ne baddamu nti, "Bifuuka ebitali birongoofu."
Kaggayi n'addamu nti, "Kale nno bwe batyo bwe bali abantu bano n'eggwanga lino. Buli kye bakola ne buli kye bawaayo ng'ekiweebwayo, si kirongoofu," bw'ayogera
" 'Kale nno, mweddeko okuva ku lunaku lwa leero, mujjukire ebiseera biri bwe byali, nga n'ejjinja erimu terinnateekebwa ku linnaalyo mu yeekaalu ya

Omuntu yenna bwe yatuukanga ku ntuumu eyandibadde ey'ebipimo amakumi abiri, yassangawo ebipimo kkumi. Omuntu yenna bwe yalaganga mu ssogolero okusenamu lita amakumi ataano, yasangangamu amakumi abiri.
Nakolimira emirimu gyonna egy'emikono gyammwe n'okugengewala n'obukuku, n'omuzira, naye ne mutakyuka kudda gye ndi,' bw'ayogera
Okuva olunaku lwa leero, olw'amakumi abiri mu ennya mu mwezi ogw'omwenda, mujjukire olunaku lwe baazimba omusingi gwa yeekaalu ya
Wakyaliwo ensigo eyasigala mu tterekero? Mulabe, emiti gino egimenyeddwa, ogw'omuzabbibu n'ogw'omutiini, n'ogw'omukomamawanga, n'ogw'omuzeeyituuni tegibalangako bibala.
ne kijjira Kaggayi omulundi ogwokubiri ku lunaku olw'amakumi abiri mu ennya olw'omwezi ogwo nga kigamba nti,
"Tegeeza Zerubbaberi gavana wa Yuda nti ndikankanya eggulu n'ensi.
Ndisulika entebe ez'obwakabaka ne nzigyawo obuyinza bw'obwakabaka obunnaggwanga. Ndiwamba amagaali n'abavuzi baago, n'embalaasi na buli abazeebagala, balittibwa baganda baabwe.
" 'Ku lunaku olwo, ggwe omuweereza wange Zerubbaberi mutabani wa Seyalutyeri, ndikufuula ng'akabonero, kubanga nkulonze,' bw'ayogera
